## Invitations

The outreach record shows that 449 people were invited. Of these, 56 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 12.5 per cent.

The figures provide a concise account of participation during the reporting period. They distinguish between the total number invited and the number who attended, while retaining the recorded rate for reference. The attendance figure should therefore be read alongside the invitation total when reviewing outreach activity and engagement.

## Contact

Contact arrangements included SMS invitations and reminder messages. A total of 397 invitations went with an SMS, and 397 people received a reminder message. These figures indicate the recorded use of SMS contact and reminders in support of the invitation process.

The information is presented for routine monitoring of outreach activity and attendance. It records the scale of invitations, participation, and follow-up contact without making assumptions beyond the reported figures.
